note: Voice activity detection model bundled with RealTimeCutVADLibrary.

name: HyperFrames

name: Alpine Linux packages (Ogent's Linux environment)
license: Various: GPL-2.0, GPL-3.0, LGPL-2.1, MPL-2.0, MIT, BSD and others
note: Ogent's Linux environment is an Alpine Linux 3.21 root file system: 257 packages (busybox, bash, git, ffmpeg, python and others), each a separate program run by the emulator, not linked into the app. Each package's license is recorded in /lib/apk/db/installed inside that environment. Source code: the aports build recipes at the source link, and the upstream sources they name. On request we provide the complete corresponding source for any GPL-licensed package, for at least three years from the last distribution of this app version.
